run_unity_dataset_processing: run the CLI tool to simplify and process GLB mesh assets for specified scene IDs
run_simplify_models: run simplify_models to decimate GLB meshes in parallel using multiprocessing and a job list
run_find_model_paths_in_scenes: run find_model_paths_in_scenes to discover all GLB model paths referenced by scene instance configs
run_get_model_ids_from_scene_instance_js: run get_model_ids_from_scene_instance_json to extract unique model template names from a scene instance JSON file
run_find_files: run find_files to recursively discover files in a directory matching a discriminator function like file_is_glb
